title: ActionAnalyze network evidence contract draft
$comment: For evidence already obtained inside the authorized sample. Projector and archive owners agreed on the RawRecord shape. Project integration owns the readback linkage and separate native-source and blob evidence.

pid.$comment: Verified nonzero payload PID. The serialized field is a uint32 decimal string.

common.$comment: sourceId is the source owner's text label. sourceEpoch identifies the subscription instance. clockDomain 1 is QPC with a positive frequencyHz. clockDomain 2 is FILETIME with frequencyHz null.

rawMetadata.$comment: RawRecord type 3, version 1, flags 0, in raw Stored blocks. The containing segment header binds projectId and sampleId. The existing little-endian metadata byte count delimits up to 1536 UTF-8 metadata bytes, followed by up to 65536 binary bytes. The binary tail contains the actual captured communication bytes. Retain any already-captured source-record bytes unchanged in a separately typed RawRecord with the original source binding. Loss and EOF records carry an empty tail. Validate metadata identity against the source binding and decode u64 strings in range before using them. The writer queues at most 256 rows and 4194304 retained payload bytes. A block contains at most 64 records including any loss record. At maximum record size its decoded body is at most 4294912 bytes, within the existing 8388608-byte Stored block decoded limit.

flow.$comment: Retain source-native endpoints, original clock ticks and optional source sequence. Tag values for direction are inbound 1 and outbound 2. Tag values for protocol are TCP 6 and UDP 17. A flow requires a verified process creation time. Unresolved metadata from a scoped PID stays outside this record variant. observedBytes preserves the source measurement, such as ETW size. originalLength describes the captured layer. Require capturedLength to equal both the inline tail size and min(producerCapturedLength, 65536). A known originalLength must be at least producerCapturedLength and strictly greater if sourceTruncated is true. Derive truncated if the source marked truncation, the writer retained a prefix, or capturedLength is smaller than the known originalLength. Otherwise derive no-payload for originalLength zero, complete for a known positive length, or captured for an unknown originalLength. A zero-byte captured observation with unknown originalLength leaves payload presence unknown. For producerCapturedLength above 65536, the default returns NeedsBlob. The caller can explicitly request retaining the 65536-byte prefix.

captureLayer.$comment: The legacy RawSocketIp PacketRecord supplies at most 4096 bytes to the ip-packet layer. The archive inline limit is 65536 bytes. Preserve the source's actual retained length and truncation evidence. The typed collector descriptor carries the source epoch and owner-assigned observation ordinal. Preserve the original Unix millisecond timestamp in source evidence and use the overflow-checked FILETIME value for the FILETIME source tick.

loss.$comment: Counts are deltas for this binding. Require a nonzero count or sourceLossUnquantified. A saturated counter has value 18446744073709551615. Unquantified loss carries no per-flow attribution.

verifiedOutboundLink.$comment: Project-integration readback projection. Resolve eventOrdinal as the sample's CanonicalEvent ordinal. Its primaryRawRecordSequence must equal rawRecordSequence. Resolve that record in rawSegmentOrdinal of the same project and sample. Match the event's source dictionary and epoch to the raw source binding. Confirm outbound direction and strong process attribution before projecting the destination address and port from the source-native fields. A non-null checkpoint generation requires published raw and records prefixes and dependency closure. A recovered tail uses null. Write source dictionaries and raw or blob data before the dependent event. Flush those dependencies before publishing the checkpoint.

reservedLargeEvidenceSlice.$comment: Reserved use of the existing content-addressed BlobStore for communication evidence above the inline cap. The blob must resolve in the owning sample with a verified SHA-256 and in-bounds slice. Match slice length to retained byte length and verify checkpoint dependency closure before publishing the reference. The current RawRecord network adapter covers inline storage only.
